pages.aboutBody:
Dəyiş is a platform that lets people in Azerbaijan swap their things with each other for free and safely. Our mission is simple: give a second life to things sitting unused at home, help families save money and make consumption more sustainable.

Platforms like Tap.az and Lalafo are great for buying and selling. Dəyiş focuses on swapping: smart matching, a fairness meter, counter-offers and swaps that complete only when both sides confirm.
pages.safetyBody:
1. Always meet in busy, well-lit places with cameras: shopping malls (28 Mall, Ganjlik Mall, Park Bulvar), metro station entrances, outside bank branches.
2. Inspect the item carefully on the spot. For phones, check the IMEI with *#06# and whether it is registered.
3. Never transfer money in advance, and never share card details or SMS codes.
4. Be careful with offers that look suspiciously cheap.
5. Keep the conversation inside the platform — it serves as evidence in a dispute.
6. Swapping prohibited items (weapons, medicines, counterfeits, live animals) is not allowed.
7. If something goes wrong, report the listing or user right away.
pages.termsBody: By using Dəyiş you agree to these terms. The platform acts as an intermediary connecting users and is not a party to any swap. Users are responsible for the accuracy and legality of their listings. Posting items that violate the laws of the Republic of Azerbaijan is prohibited. Paid services (bump, VIP, Plus) are non-refundable once delivered. The platform reserves the right to block listings and accounts that break the rules without notice.
pages.privacyBody: We only collect data needed to provide the service: name, email, phone (optional), city and your listings. Passwords are stored hashed. EXIF/GPS data is automatically removed from uploaded photos. Your phone number is not shown to other users — communication happens through the in-app chat. We do not sell your data to third parties. You can contact support to delete your account.

pages.advertiseBody:
Dəyiş brings together thousands of active users every day — not just in Baku but across Azerbaijan. Put your brand in front of a thrifty, tech-curious audience that loves swapping.
Ad formats: home page banner, banners between search results, listing page sidebar and sponsored categories.
Special offer for shops and businesses: offer your products for swap or at a discount with a "Business profile".
Contact: ads@deyis.az
